finding.statement: The current cut has a long linear build, a dense pulse burst, and a comparatively flat closing hold. The nominal animation schedule reaches the live text at 5.45s, spends 1.68s on seven pulse pairs, then uses 2.85s for orbit/parcels/labels/seal/footer before a 1.0s hold.
finding.impact: The visual beat is front-loaded into sequential reveals and does not recur as a clear motif after the agent cluster is established. This makes the habitat feel assembled once, rather than continuously alive.

candidate_change.change: Re-time the existing reveal into three readable beats: setup (title/floor/root), cluster (limbs/nodes/labels), and receipt (pulses/orbits/parcels/seal). Keep all source-bound objects, camera, copy, colors, and semantics unchanged. Use 0.15s breathing gaps between the cluster sub-beats, pulse the 13 working nodes in two alternating groups (7+6) with 0.10s up and 0.10s down per node, and reduce the terminal hold from 1.0s to 0.6s so the closing beat lands without a long plateau.
candidate_change.success_criterion: The same information remains legible while motion has three discernible beats and no single reveal block exceeds 1.0s without a visual change.

evidence.measurement: Explicit run_time values sum to 5.45s through live_text; pulses[:7] contributes 7 * (0.12s + 0.12s) = 1.68s; orbit/parcels/task_text/seal/footer contributes 2.85s; self.wait(1.0) adds the terminal hold.
evidence.basis: Source inspection of lines 28-121; no production file changed.

evidence.measurement: ffprobe reports 854x480, 15 fps, 172 frames, and 11.466016s duration.
evidence.basis: Read-only ffprobe measurement of the provided showcase video.

evidence.measurement: At 1.0s sampling, frame-difference luma average is 2.14098 at 1.06667s but 0.00172473 at 11.066s, consistent with a strong early transition and a nearly static closing hold.
evidence.basis: Read-only ffmpeg tblend= difference + signalstats sample; this is a motion proxy, not a perceptual score.

evidence.measurement: The snapshot contains 13 working agents, 2 idle agents, and 60 tasks; the candidate preserves those counts and the read-only claim.

falsifier: Reject this candidate if a rendered A/B review shows that the three beats are not reliably identifiable at normal playback, if any agent/task count or source-bound label changes, or if the motion proxy and blinded human ratings show no improvement or a regression in perceived continuity.
next_measurement: Render the timing-only candidate to a separate preview, then compare it with the supplied video using 15 fps frame-difference energy by 0.25s bins and a blinded 5-point visual-rhythm rating from at least 3 reviewers. Record duration, beat-boundary timestamps, readability, and any semantic drift.
